'''Gwhirrye Nekor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] individual living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] he traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. He was assigned to the [[Underworld Logistics]] branch of the Alliance under [[Hylo Visz]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gwhirrye Nekor appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion as a vendor inside [[Alliance base|Odessen base]].
